messages:
jen: Heads up — found a broken fragment and weird image rendering on the /sdk page. Clicking 'Embedding guide' jumps to a fragment id that doesn't exist (:eyes:)

jen: On mobile the API example image looks stretched; looks like srcset fallthrough to a 2x asset with an absolute path that 404s.

alex: can you paste the link and the failing anchor? I'll take a quick look.

jen: /sdk/quickstart -> anchor #embedding-overview (404). PR that added anchor: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3412

kevin: hmm PR 3412 added a heading but the ID generator used by mkdocs slugify produced `embedding-overview-` (trailing dash) because of soft hyphen in the heading. mkdocs linkcheck ignores trailing dashes.

maria: ugh. Soft hyphen strikes again. We should normalize heading ids in frontmatter for that page. Quick fix: add explicit `id` with HTML anchor or explicit header id in markdown:

maria: ```md
### Embedding overview {#embedding-overview}
```

samir: for the stretched image — can you give the image markdown? suspect wrong srcset with leading slash on relative build output.

jen: image snippet on page:

jen: ```md
![API diagram](../assets/images/sdk/api-diagram@2x.png)
```

jen: on build the 2x asset ends up at `/_assets/...` and the relative path becomes `/_assets/../assets/...` which 404s.

kevin: that's because the image was referenced from an included file (mdx include) and our mkdocs-url-normalize plugin doesn't rewrite srcset for included partials.

kevin: I can patch plugin to run url normalization on include renders. Meanwhile quick workaround: change to absolute asset path in page frontmatter baseurl or use `{{ base_url }}/assets/...`.

alex: recommend shipping tiny patch: add explicit header id and fix image path in the same PR, run linkcheck locally with `mkdocs build --verbose && python tools/linkcheck.py`.

docs-bot: Deploy preview for branch jen/docs-fix-embed-image is available: https://deploy.preview.redwood-inference.com/pr/jen-docs-fix-embed-image

jen: thanks — pushed branch jen/docs-fix-embed-image with both fixes + unit for mkdocs plugin. cc @kevin for plugin review.

kevin: on it. will add regression test for included-file url rewriting and a note in changelog.

maria: also add a brief blurb in migration guide about soft hyphen -> explicit ids; we've tripped multiple teams.

samir: test pass locally for me. linkcheck shows 0 broken anchors.

alex: ok let's merge after CI. thx folks :thumbsup:
